purpose: Bind every selected core and extension replacement to reviewed immutable bytes without granting collection, paper, alert, or order authority.

es_stream.ledger: independent ES score, setup, outcome, and position ledgers

eurusd_stream.ledger: independent EURUSD score, setup, outcome, and position ledgers

instrument_separation.cross_stream_rule: Never run OTE models on ES bars, and never sum or rank ES ticks/USD and EURUSD pips as one P&L series.

comparison_protocol_intent.common_opportunity_universe: Construct before threshold, policy, cost, capacity, or outcome inspection from every causally available prediction with an exact same-side contemporaneous setup match under the frozen matcher and source identity.

branches.setup_only: Every common opportunity; no probability filter or full-policy gate.
branches.model_threshold: The same common opportunities with the later replacement's development/OOF-frozen threshold applied; no C1 retuning.
branches.full_policy: The same common opportunities after the exact candidate-specific policy binding is frozen. If no exact binding exists, record full_policy as not_defined/insufficient_evidence and do not report zero P&L.

comparison_protocol_intent.retention: Retain raw below-threshold scores, both/A-only/B-only/neither pair states, exact overlap identity, independent outcomes, rejected opportunities, capacity rejections, and unresolved/open exposure.
comparison_protocol_intent.pooled_routing: Use the detector-selected contemporaneous same-side setup as the primary executable contract; retain non-executable counterfactual model-by-setup markouts without attaching later setups or selecting the best setup after outcomes.

collection_controls.ledgers: One independent position ledger per model/variant plus a separately named one-position-per-instrument policy ledger; never mix them in ranking.
collection_controls.promotion: No selected entry is promotion-cleared, installed, paper-authorized, or order-authorized by v0.

source_history_contract.clock_note: Consecutive observed source bars; availability, scheduled gaps, closures and rolls are separate gates

b2_recipe_and_data_parent.preserved_constraints: 730-day recency half-life, 0.20 floor, train/validation weighting, unchanged test weights

admission_rule: B2 review freezes identity only. Scored shadow admission remains fail-closed until exact B3/B4 trading rules, B5 parity, B6 staging, A12 latency, and B7 readiness pass for these same hashes.
legacy_swap_rule: Any byte, feature order, calibrator, threshold, matcher, or policy change requires a new selection/freeze version and clean collection boundary.
